description: Image manifest for the existing approved homepage. Each entry documents one homepage image slot: its slot name, page section, expected purpose, and local image path. The homepage connects to this manifest through matching data-image-slot attributes on its existing elements. No slot changes any visual design; paths and imagery are unchanged.
